cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluated new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpreted engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organizes the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to the current EH& standards.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Previous experience as a Manufacturing Engineer, or similar role
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques
Commitment to health and safety standards and environmental regulations
Project management skills
Problem-solving ability
Teamwork skills
Computer literate, including Microsoft Office applications
Preferred Requirements
Well-versed in relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office)
Knowledge of machining and automated machines
A degree in engineering or a related industry
5 Years experience in a Manufacturing Engineering capacity
Will consider candidates with less experience who demonstrate a willingness to learn and who have a strong aptitude regarding the above requirements.

cond_0062.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. You will own the evaluation of manufacturing processes, create sequenced work instructions, lead Continuous Improvement initiatives, implement mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) practices, prioritize workflow, integrate standardization, and direct tooling requirements. This role demands solid knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, a firm commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and strong project management skills. Creative and progressive thinking are essential to succeed as a manufacturing engineer.
cond_0062.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Lead technical solutions for Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Execute capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually to enhance quality, reduce cost, and improve production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Assess new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpret engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organize the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then determine and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Direct coordination with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to current EH&S standards.
cond_0062.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Previous experience as a Manufacturing Engineer, or similar role
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques
Commitment to health and safety standards and environmental regulations
Well-versed in relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office)
Project management skills
Problem-solving ability
Teamwork skills
5 Years experience in a Manufacturing Engineering capacity
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of machining and automated machines
Computer literate, including Microsoft Office applications
A degree in engineering or a related industry
Candidates with less than 5 years of experience who demonstrate a willingness to learn and a strong aptitude regarding the above requirements will also be considered.

Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product.

Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).

Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations, and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluate new tooling required for legacy products.
Identify and reduce waste to support Continuous Improvement in costs.
Interpret engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organize the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Coordinate with Facilities and EH&S Manager to confirm all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to current EH&S standards.

The role involves evaluating manufacturing processes, creating sequenced work instructions, leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing practices, prioritizing workflow, integrating standardization, and updating tooling requirements. Good knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and project management skills are all important in this position. Most people become stronger in this kind of manufacturing engineering work over time as they build experience and learn from the processes around them.
cond_0149.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluate new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpret engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organize the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to current EH&S standards.
cond_0149.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Previous experience as a Manufacturing Engineer, or similar role
5 Years experience in a Manufacturing Engineering capacity
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques
Commitment to health and safety standards and environmental regulations
Project management skills
Problem-solving ability
Teamwork skills
Computer literate, including Microsoft Office applications
Preferred Requirements
Well-versed in relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office)
Knowledge of machining and automated machines
A degree in engineering or a related industry
Will consider candidates with less experience who demonstrate a willingness to learn and who have a strong aptitude regarding the above requirements.

cond_0288.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team. The role involves evaluating manufacturing processes, coordinating work instructions, supporting Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) practices, and helping integrate standardization and tooling requirements. Working alongside engineering and production teams, you will contribute knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, a commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and project management skills.
cond_0288.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering supports the assembly, fabrication, and production lines to work efficiently and effectively, delivering a timely and defect-free product that satisfies customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then coordinate the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Support Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Work with the team to evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Collaborate on continual analysis of manufacturing process flows for enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Help optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Coordinate implementation of LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Assess new tooling required for legacy products.
Support Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpret engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and help organize the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then work with relevant teams to recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Help resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work alongside the Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to current EH&S standards.

cond_0301.intro: [Company name masked] operates a number of shops at its facility in [Location masked]. From fabricating and machining raw materials into parts, molding fiberglass components, welding subassemblies, and fuselages, assembly of components, small items, and large component paint, all the way up to the wing and aircraft assembly operations, a significant portion of the aircraft is manufactured in-house. The position involves evaluating manufacturing processes, creating sequenced work instructions, leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) practices, prioritizing workflow and integrating standardization, and updating tooling requirements. Good knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, a commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and project management skills are all needed. Creative and progressive thinking are required to be a competent manufacturing engineer. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and how the different parts of production fit together.

From fabricating and machining raw materials into parts, molding fiberglass components, welding subassemblies, and fuselages, assembly of components, small items, and large component paint, all the way up to the wing and aircraft assembly operations, a significant portion of the aircraft is manufactured in-house. The position involves evaluating manufacturing processes, creating sequenced work instructions, leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) practices, prioritizing workflow and integrating standardization, and updating tooling requirements. You will need to have good knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, exemplify a commitment to quality, be familiar with safety and environmental standards, and utilize project management skills. Creative and progressive thinking are required to be a competent manufacturing engineer. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and how the different parts of production fit together.
cond_0310.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluated new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpreted engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organizes the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to the current EH& standards.
cond_0310.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Previous experience as a Manufacturing Engineer, or similar role
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques
Commitment to health and safety standards and environmental regulations
Well-versed in relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office)
Project management skills
Problem-solving ability
Teamwork skills
5 Years experience in a Manufacturing Engineering capacity
Computer literate, including Microsoft Office applications
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of machining and automated machines
A degree in engineering or a related industry
Will consider candidates with less experience who demonstrate a willingness to learn and who have a strong aptitude regarding the above requirements.
cond_0310.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.

cond_0354.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0354.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluated new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpreted engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organizes the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to the current EH& standards.
cond_0354.requirements:
Experience in a Manufacturing Engineering role or similar, ideally around 5 years, though candidates with less experience who show a willingness to learn are welcome to apply.
Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design.
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques.
Comfort with health and safety standards and environmental regulations.
Familiarity with relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office), including general computer literacy with Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to manage projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
Willingness to work through problems and find practical solutions.
Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Background in machining and automated machines is a plus.
A degree in engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is an advantage.

cond_0365.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked]. The facility manufactures a significant portion of aircraft in-house, covering fabrication, machining, molding, welding, assembly, and paint operations. The role involves evaluating manufacturing processes, creating sequenced work instructions, leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing practices, prioritizing workflow, integrating standardization, and updating tooling requirements. Good knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and project management skills are all important in this position. Most people become stronger in this kind of manufacturing engineering work over time as they build experience and learn from the processes around them.
cond_0365.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluate new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpret engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organize the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to current EH&S standards.

cond_0443.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0443.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluated new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpreted engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organizes the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to the current EH& standards.
cond_0443.requirements:
Proven track record as a Manufacturing Engineer or in a similar role.
Advanced knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design.
Strong command of manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques.
Demonstrated commitment to health and safety standards and environmental regulations.
Deep knowledge of relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office).
Strong project management skills.
Exceptional problem-solving ability.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in a Manufacturing Engineering capacity.
Solid understanding of machining and automated machines preferred.
Strong command of Microsoft Office applications.
A degree in engineering or a related field is required; an advanced degree is strongly preferred.

This role involves evaluating manufacturing processes, creating sequenced work instructions, leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) practices, prioritizing workflow, integrating standardization, and updating tooling requirements. The role requires solid knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, a commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and project management skills.
cond_0475.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering supports assembly, fabrication, and production lines to deliver a timely and defect-free product.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Provide technical solutions to Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality as required.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows for enhancements in quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations, and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures on the manufacturing floor.
Evaluate new tooling required for legacy products.
Reduce costs through waste reduction and Continuous Improvement.
Interpret engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organize the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Coordinate with the Facilities and EH&S Manager to confirm all manufacturing processes and tooling meet current EH&S standards.
cond_0475.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Previous experience as a Manufacturing Engineer or in a similar role
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques
Commitment to health and safety standards and environmental regulations
Proficiency in relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office)
Project management skills
Problem-solving ability
5 Years of experience in a Manufacturing Engineering capacity
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of machining and automated machines
A degree in engineering or a related field
Teamwork skills
Candidates with less than 5 years of experience who demonstrate a willingness to learn and a strong aptitude for the above requirements will also be considered.

The position involves evaluating manufacturing processes, creating sequenced work instructions, leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) practices, prioritizing workflow and integrating standardization, and updating tooling requirements. Good knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, a commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and project management skills are needed. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manufacturing engineering work.
cond_0554.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluated new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpreted engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organizes the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to the current EH& standards.
cond_0554.requirements:
Previous experience as a Manufacturing Engineer, or similar role
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques

cond_0588.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0588.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering is necessary to ensure our assembly, fabrication, and production lines work efficiently and effectively to deliver a timely and defect-free product, which satisfies our customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then organize the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Assist Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Analyze manufacturing process flows continually for the enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Implement LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Evaluated new tooling required for legacy products.
Drive Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpreted engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and organizes the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work with Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to the current EH& standards.
cond_0588.requirements:
Experience in a Manufacturing Engineering role or similar, ideally around 5 years, though candidates with less experience who show a willingness to learn are welcome to apply.
Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design.
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques.
Comfort with health and safety standards and environmental regulations.
Familiarity with relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office), including general computer literacy with Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to manage projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
Willingness to work through problems and find practical solutions.
Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Background in machining and automated machines is a plus.
A degree in engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is an advantage.
cond_0588.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

The role involves evaluating manufacturing processes, coordinating work instructions, supporting Continuous Improvement initiatives, implementing mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) practices, and helping integrate standardization and tooling requirements. Working alongside engineering and production teams, you will contribute knowledge of tool design and fabrication methods, a commitment to quality, familiarity with safety and environmental standards, and project management skills.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Manufacturing Engineering supports the assembly, fabrication, and production lines to work efficiently and effectively, delivering a timely and defect-free product that satisfies customers.
Interpret engineering drawings and specifications for assemblies and sub-assemblies, then coordinate the production build process into a logical, efficient, and standardized series of operations using a manufacturing Execution System (MES).
Support Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Quality by providing technical solutions.
Maintain EBOM, MBOM, and ABOM aircraft configuration.
Perform capability and productibility studies from engineering drawings.
Work with the team to evaluate manufacturing processes for ways to improve quality, safety, efficiency, and speed (rate).
Collaborate on continual analysis of manufacturing process flows for enhancements of quality, cost reduction, and production.
Help optimize facility layouts, production lines, machine operations and network performance.
Coordinate implementation of LEAN process control techniques and procedures onto the manufacturing floor.
Assess new tooling required for legacy products.
Support Continuous Improvement in costs through waste reduction.
Interpret engineering drawings of assemblies and sub-assemblies and help organize the production process into a logical and efficient series of tasks.
Perform Root Cause analysis (RC) to determine failure, then work with relevant teams to recommend and implement Corrective Action (CA).
Help resolve issues and delays in production.
Train production personnel in new and existing MES processes.
Ensure that manufacturing procedures follow safety and environmental regulations.
Work alongside the Facilities and EH&S Manager to ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling adhere to current EH&S standards.
cond_0648.requirements:
Previous experience as a Manufacturing Engineer, or similar role
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, fabrication methods, and tool design
Familiarity with manufacturing equipment and quality assurance techniques
Commitment to health and safety standards and environmental regulations
Well-versed in relevant software (e.g. CAD, MS Office)
Project management skills
Problem-solving ability
Teamwork skills
5 Years experience in a Manufacturing Engineering capacity. Will consider candidates with less experience who demonstrate a willingness to learn and who have a strong aptitude regarding the above requirements.
Knowledge of machining and automated machines is preferred.
Computer literate, including Microsoft Office applications.
A degree in engineering or a related industry is a plus.
